{{Quote|Don't really know the details, but it looks like Torch moved her whole clan to another island here on Rishi. I've got the coordinates.|[[Theron Shan]]|<ref name="Blood" />}}
'''Tracyn Island''' was an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]],<ref name="Blood" /> located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Mandalorian_Enclave_Coliseum-Rishi.jpg|thumb|left|The Mandalorian Coliseum on Tracyn Island]]
Named for the word ''tracyn'', meaning "[[Fire/Legends|fire]]" in the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[language]] of ''[[Mando'a]]'',<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref> the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] Tracyn Island was occupied by a [[Clan Vizla|clan]] of Mandalorians during the [[Galactic War]]. Led by [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]], the Mandalorians moved to the island after they split with the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and they built an island-wide enclave to keep a number of creatures to test themselves against. Shortly before the [[Battle of Rishi]], a group of independent operatives traveled to Tracyn Island and bested the clan's challenges in order to speak with Vizla.<ref name="Blood" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tracyn Island appears as the main location in "Blood Hunt," a Flashpoint added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.
